reason: I already have a site and I already pay for POS, accounting and the delivery apps eating my margin. Another 25 a month plus VAT to move everything over is not something I do in a normal week; the lunch special I just write on the board and post on Facebook.
objection: Moving off my current site is a hassle and one more monthly fee on top of all the others. And I don't trust an AI to put the right price up without me checking it every day anyway.
would_change_my_mind: If it worked with the site I already have instead of making me move, and the first months were free so I could see it actually saves me time on the daily special.
